integrity: Exact all-n analytic proof including local uniqueness and two-step Floquet minimax; checker supplies nonexhaustive numerical corroboration only. No independent scientific validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: For the even unweighted rings considered, the two-cycle is hyperbolically attracting in the common-phase quotient for 1/2<h<pi/4 and nonhyperbolically locally asymptotically attracting at h=pi/4. Global basins and other cycles are not classified, and the literature comparison is not exhaustive.
title: A sharp period-doubling branch and optimally damped transverse modes in even Huygens rings
